bug: DF-1 .. DF-12 computed the daily-flat sleeves on the PATCHED bars (16:00 ET bar = 0, session-open gaps removed) for BOTH the P&L and the SIGNALS. A trader sees the true prices: e.g. CL's 21-day change at 2026-09-30 was +3.8% on true prices but -3.1% on the patched series, which flipped the OIL sleeve for October 2026 (found by comparing the swing and daily-flat paper ledgers).
fix: signals / positions of the 8 equity-index sleeves from the TRUE bars (scripts/v99/dailyflat_positions.py with QPL_DF_SIGNALS=true), P&L on the patched bars (flat 16:00-18:00 ET and at weekends, gaps not earned), costs = turnover of the hourly positions incl. the exit / re-entry at every closure (as DF-4b), per sleeve and net; fbook rule (1/sd on 2010-22, positive Sharpe)
consequence: replaces DF-3 / DF-4 as the daily-flat reference; every DF-5 .. DF-12 comparison was made on the flawed series and is re-read against the corrected reference only where it matters
